project_type: Go backend (chi router) + Angular 22 SPA frontend (standalone components, signals, Tailwind CSS 4, pnpm)
build_system: Make for Go backend, pnpm for Angular frontend. `make build` does both (runs ui-build first). `make build-no-ui` for Go only.
test_framework: Go test for backend, Vitest for frontend (ui/vitest.config.ts). Tests are run with `make test` (Go) and `pnpm --prefix ui run test --watch=false` (Angular/Vitest).
build_command: pnpm --prefix ui install && pnpm --prefix ui run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run `pnpm --prefix ui install` to install deps. 2. Run `pnpm --prefix ui run build` to verify Angular builds. 3. Run `cd ui && pnpm run test --watch=false` for frontend tests. 4. Run `make build-no-ui` to verify Go backend compiles.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access for installing packages. No database available for integration tests. Frontend can be fully built and tested. Go backend can be compiled but integration tests require PostgreSQL.
contribution_requirements: Angular components use standalone mode with signals. Tailwind CSS classes inline. i18n via $localize and i18n attributes. No em dashes in code.
key_patterns: 1. Angular standalone components with inject() for DI. 2. Signals for state (signal(), computed()). 3. Service layer in ui/src/app/services/ using HttpClient. 4. Models in ui/src/app/models/. 5. Sidebar uses allNavItems array with optional children for expandable subnavs. 6. Routes defined in app.routes.ts with lazy-loaded components. 7. Backend handlers in internal/server/triage.go. 8. Profile system: builtin templates (default, internet-facing, internal-only, air-gapped), no custom profile CRUD in backend yet.
directory_structure: Root: Go backend (cmd/, internal/, migrations/). ui/: Angular 22 SPA. ui/src/app/pages/triage/: all triage page components. ui/src/app/services/: API service layer. ui/src/app/models/: TypeScript interfaces.
